metadata.venue: GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium, Kansas City, Missouri

ai_summary.key_headline: Room's Record Saves Deny Ecuador, Curacao Claims First Point
tactical_insights: Eloy Room's record-breaking 15 saves secured Curacao's historic first World Cup point against Ecuador.
The 0-0 draw highlighted Ecuador's offensive struggles despite 27 shots, threatening their early World Cup exit.
Dick Advocaat's disciplined defensive block effectively neutralized Sebastián Beccacece's high-intensity attacking Ecuador.
